title: Why Does a Hummingbird’s Heart Beat 1,200 Times Per Minute?

scenes.text: What makes a hummingbird’s heart race up to 1,200 beats each minute?
A hummingbird’s heart can beat as fast as 1,200 times per minute while hovering.
During nightly torpor, its heart slows dramatically to about 50 beats per minute.
Tiny bird, massive metabolism – the hummingbird’s heart is a powerhouse.
scenes.label: SMALL BODY BIG HEART
scenes.sub: Even the tiniest bird needs a turbocharged pump.
